title: Markets move while you're busy. Reaching for your phone breaks the moment, and trading by voice sounds risky. This is Pulse, for Even G2.
home: One glance. My Binance testnet portfolio, today's move, and live prices.
start: I start a trading session with one phrase. Pulse greets me with numbers straight from Binance.
holding: What's my biggest holding? Real balances, valued in dollars, with unpriced test coins left out.
voice: I just ask out loud. My words are transcribed live, and Pulse shows price, move and range.
why: Then, why? It answers from verified data, and says plainly what it can't confirm.
plan: Here is our idea: trade plans. I decide while I'm calm. If Bitcoin is below my level, offer to buy twenty dollars. I set it close to the market, so you can watch it fire.
fired: Pulse keeps watching, even if I close the app. When my level is reached, it brings me the order. It never trades on its own.
choose: Exact terms, a testnet banner, and reject selected by default. An accidental tap spends nothing. I swipe to approve.
approve: One tap. The backend checks everything again, Binance executes, and I see the confirmation, with a real order number.
session: How's my session? Profit and loss since I started, in one line.
sell: Selling works too. Half my Bitcoin, at my price. Pulse works out the exact amount.
place: I approve, and the order now waits on Binance.
cancel: Changed my mind. I say, cancel my order. Pulse shows exactly which one, with keep selected.
confirm: Swipe, tap, and Binance confirms it's cancelled.
remember: I tell it what I care about, and it remembers.
again: End the session, start a new one, and Pulse welcomes me back.
how: Under the hood, the glasses talk only to our backend. Approvals are locked to the exact terms, orders are never sent twice, and the AI cannot approve.
who: Made for active traders who can't live inside a phone.
closing: We're on Binance testnet right now. No withdrawals, no margin, no autonomous trading. You decide, and Binance executes. Pulse: your financial world, at a glance.
